Frequently asked questions

Common questions about respond to an unemployment overpayment notice

What is an unemployment overpayment?

The state determined you received unemployment benefits you were not entitled to — often due to later-discovered information about your separation, earnings, or eligibility. They will demand repayment.

Can I get an unemployment overpayment waived?

Many states allow waiver requests if the overpayment was not your fault and repayment would cause financial hardship. Check your state's rules and file the waiver form with financial documentation.

What if I disagree with the overpayment amount?

You can appeal the overpayment determination within the deadline. Provide evidence showing the amount is incorrect or that you were eligible for the benefits received.
